name: Kefir C compiler end2end tests

public_git_auth.source: official website publishes these read-only credentials

migration.reason: old HEAD contains only migration README, zero test sources

license.tests: GPL-3.0-only (source SPDX GPL-3.0; notice specifies version3)

contracts.host: Makefile.mk release CFLAGS plus -Wno-int-in-bool-context -UNDEBUG, headers and upstream generated host-env header
contracts.test: compile.sh flags and each *.kefir.c.profile; default C17+GNU extensions; selected Linux target replaces Kefir host-none
contracts.run: successful exit as run.sh; stdout/stderr retained, no invented stdout comparison
contracts.matrix: clang/clang reference, then clang/vcc,vcc/clang,vcc/vcc host/test groups
outside_scope: ARM tests containing x86 guards, intrinsics or inline assembly; no inactive-guard passes
Kefir decimal capability-guarded tests: no inactive guard passes and no forged capability macros
contracts.profiles: Initialize upstream compile.sh base flags before sourcing profile; preserve append, substitution and replacement; record raw text, base/final flags, mapped flags and supported environment

snapshot: Require clean checkout at pinned HEAD; git archive exact pin, record tree ID and every file SHA256
